review: Reviewed actual Moss request and accepted world-22 specification at tick 13. Implement the minimal persistent assessment only: baseline/observation cost 0.2 energy and a round; two physical work rounds cost one energy each, uncovering then replacing actual displaced soil. Exact plot identity, paid progress, specimen age, exposure and original material persist through other actions and recovery. Creator permission and one transaction-bound work lock prevent unauthorized handling and duplicate work. Cancellation/death release the work lock without free reburial, material or refunds. Covered specimen quantities and spoil events are hidden only while this scoped package is installed; earlier frames remain identical. Other learned people may independently observe public state. Existing grounded-understanding receives deduplicated real changed evidence through a shared trigger, with no completion, timer or learning reward. No propagation, harvest, new biomass or claimed tending benefit is implemented in this precursor. Generic visual metadata distinguishes actual covered/exposed state without revealing covered items. Exact tests cover visibility, costs, continuity, death, permission and material conservation. Reused baseline and ex12 helpers are attributed. The adapter must pass full tests and source-prefix replay before resumption; actual use and benefit are not claimed by these fixtures.
